messages:
incident-bot: REALTIME ALERT: p95 detector tripped for hosted-eu-central (p95 > 650ms) across gen endpoints. Please triage. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/rt/p95-overview?region=eu-central
ajay: ack. joining. pulling p95/p99 panels + tail traces.
maria: seeing p95 ~710ms and p99 ~1.6s for /v1/generate; streaming connection stalls up ~6x relative to baseline. No spike in 5xx yet.
carol: did anyone push runtime or kernel changes recently?
maria: there was a runtime kernel selector tweak and a continuous-batching param bump 18m ago (change ref: kb-2026-88). Also a lightweight quant profile applied to one variant ~12m ago.
sreepu: running live pod tails: `kubectl -n inference logs -l zone=eu-central -f --since=20m` — seeing many redis cache miss latencies and a handful of grpc connection resets to the stream proxy.
ops-handoff: whats the customer impact window?
maria: initial sample: about 5% of requests >2s, concentrated on long-sequence customers and batch exports. Streaming stalls cause partial payload duplications for a small subset.
ajay: quick metric sweep: cache hit rate dropped from 81% -> 38% over 15m; kernel selector logs show increased fallback to generic kernels about the time of the batch param change. Could be combined effect.
incident-bot: TRACE QUERY: `service:inference AND region:eu-central AND duration>1500ms` -> 198 traces in last 15m.
carol: infra: redis cluster latency shows a tail at ~900-1200ms, CPU on master nodes at 80%, connection queue high. Might be a client-side amplification due to longer batch windows.
sreepu: hypothesis: batching parameter increased request coalescing which caused larger backend load and more cache misses due to changed prefix access patterns. That pushed redis over threshold -> tail latency -> streaming stalls.
ops-handoff: recommend immediate mitigations: 1) revert batching param to previous value, 2) temporarily route long-seq traffic to legacy variant, 3) request burst capacity for eu-central. Approve?
ajay: I approve. Rollback batch param first to minimize risk of rollback ripple.
maria: rolling back batch param: `curl -X POST https://config.internal/ops/params/kb-2026-88/rollback -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"` applied at 2820009999.
incident-bot: ACTION: rollback of kb-2026-88 recorded at 2820010012.
sreepu: submitting capacity request: `cloudctl cap request --region eu-central --gpu 6 --type burst --reason "latency mitigation"` request id cap-eu-2820 submitted.
infra-ops: received cap request; spinning up burst nodes, ETA ~3-5m. Noted redis cluster under pressure, opening infra ticket to scale read replicas and investigate eviction policy.
ajay: traffic split: routing rule update to move /v1/longgen and high-token routes to variant-legacy for 35% of matching tenants. Patch applied at 2820010075.
carol: apply emergency rate limits for large seq routes to prevent overloaded tails: `rlctl apply --route /v1/longgen --qps 40 --burst 80`
cs-lead: contacting affected customers now for visibility; one enterprise export in-progress flagged and asked them to pause. CS note queued at 2820010102.
maria: monitoring after actions: p95 dropped to ~480ms within 2 minutes; p99 at ~1.1s; streaming stall rate down to ~1.4% from peak ~6.2%.
incident-bot: snapshots stored: https://incidents.redwood.ai/board/2820009999 
ops-handoff: escalation thresholds: escalate to oncall-sre-2 if p99 > 2s for 10 consecutive minutes or error rate > 0.8% for 5 minutes. Current p99 trending down, below threshold.
sreepu: I'm taking live watch. Plan: 1) monitor for 30m with 5m check-ins, 2) if redis tail persists after burst nodes up, roll redis-read replicas by adding 2 read nodes and tune eviction, 3) open incident doc with timeline and owners.
carol: infra note: redis read replicas being added now (action id infra-2820-1). Also investigating whether eviction policy changed when quant profile applied earlier.
ajay: start lightweight smoke test for affected tenant flows: `for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -X POST https://hosted-eu-central/v1/generate -d @payload.json; sleep 0.5; done` will report latencies. I'll run from eu probe.
maria: run shows median 220ms, p95 460ms, p99 ~980ms across the test set. Good improvement but keep watching production traffic.
cs-lead: informed customers at 2820010288: we applied mitigations and are monitoring; offered to rerun paused exports under supervision. One customer requested a post-incident writeup.
ops-handoff: please capture timeline: param change -> quant profile -> onset of spike -> mitigations -> residuals. Owners: eng-runtime (batching param), eng-ml (quant profile), infra-redis. Postmortem owners assigned.
sreepu: will own mitigations and continue checks every 10 minutes for next 30 minutes. I'll escalate earlier if p99 creeps back above 1.8s.
ajay: thanks all. Note to run a regression test against kernel selector logic in staging.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RECORD: status=monitoring; severity=high; assigned=sreepu; started=2820009999; mitigation_tags=[rollback,kernel,batching,redis]
pagerbot: paging summary posted to #sre-paging. @sreepu acknowledged.
maria: final metric snapshot at 2820010599: p95 430ms p99 920ms stream-stall 0.7%. leaving thread to watch.
